adeptuscustodes/rules/army_rules/Martial:
Start of your Command phase
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability: readied
While a unit is readied: may select 1 ka'tah ability below for it to use
- once selected, that unit is no longer readied

Conversai
Timing: your Command phase
Select: a friendly readied unit
Result:
- being engaged/Battle-shocked does not stop the unit being eligible to start an action
- starting an action does not stop the unit being eligible to shoot
Duration: until end of turn

Calistus
Timing: your Movement phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to move
Select: that readied unit
Result: when making a normal move/advance move/fall-back move, the unit may move through any type of model

Salvus
Timing: your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot
Select: that readied unit
Result: unit may ignore modifiers to its:
- BS
- hit rolls and wound rolls

Dacatarai
Timing: start of the Fight phase
Select: a friendly readied unit
Result: unit's melee attacks targeting an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) may re-roll hit rolls of 1

Kaptaris
Timing: start of the Fight phase
Select: a friendly readied unit
Result: melee attacks targeting the unit: -1 to hit rolls

Rendax
Timing: Fight phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to fight
Select: a friendly readied unit
Result: unit's melee attacks: [LETHAL HITS: MONSTER/VEHICLE] gained

Favoured Ka'tah
- detachments tagged 'Unique: Shield Host' each state a Favoured Ka'tah
- if such a detachment is selected: its Favoured Ka'tah ability also gets the additional effect listed in that detachment
